front.title: Traffic Steering Considerations for SR-MPLS and SRv6

abstract.t: This document describes traffic steering mechanisms for both Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) and Segment Routing over MPLS (SR-MPLS). It provides an overview of the main traffic steering methods applicable to both architectures, including steering based on destination addresses (BSID/Binding Label, Color/Endpoint, IGP Shortcut) and flow characteristics (DSCP, 802.1p, Service-class, TE-class, BGP- FlowSpec). Furthermore, it discusses the recommended traffic steering methods for various typical scenarios, highlighting the interoperability and specific handling differences between SR-MPLS and SRv6 where necessary.
